headline: 1,081 deaths as measles outbreak worsens in Bangladesh
summary: Five more patients died in 24 hours, bringing the total number of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 1,081 this year.
details: Five more patients with measles-like symptoms died within 24 hours, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
This brings the country's combined tally of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 1,081 this year.
Of the total deaths, 980 are classified as suspected and 101 are laboratory-confirmed.
In the last 24 hours, 1,183 new suspected cases were reported, adding to a cumulative total of 184,632 suspected infections nationwide.
Additionally, 100 new confirmed cases were recorded, bringing the total number of laboratory-confirmed infections to 20,951.
Since March 15, a total of 163,153 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalized across the country, with 156,744 recovering.
The DGHS continues to monitor the situation as the number of cases and suspected deaths continue to rise.
caption:
1,081 deaths and over 184,000 suspected cases. The measles outbreak in Bangladesh is escalating.

Five more patients with measles-like symptoms died within 24 hours, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

This brings the country's combined tally of confirmed and suspected measles-related deaths to 1,081 this year.

Of the total deaths, 980 are classified as suspected and 101 are laboratory-confirmed.

In the last 24 hours, 1,183 new suspected cases were reported, adding to a cumulative total of 184,632 suspected infections nationwide.

Additionally, 100 new confirmed cases were recorded, bringing the total number of laboratory-confirmed infections to 20,951.

Since March 15, a total of 163,153 patients with suspected measles have been hospitalized across the country, with 156,744 recovering.

The DGHS continues to monitor the situation as the number of cases and suspected deaths continue to rise.
